integrity: Analytical proof reconstructed and supported by independent finite-case integer checks; finite computations are not an infinite proof. No independent audit or verification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Bilateral prime-field difference automaton only, two non-singleton blocks separated by a prime power, not arbitrary cellular automata or general disconnected sets. Earlier arithmetic-progression predecessor-trace laws cover singleton special cases and are not claimed here. Earlier qualitative literature and potentially inaccessible historical quantitative work remain priority risks.
title: Frobenius plateaux in finite-time cylinder covering for additive cellular automata
